verses.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.pt: Eu sou o homem que viu a aflição causada pela vara do seu furor.
verses.en_web: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.en_bbe: I am the man who has seen trouble by the rod of his wrath.

verses.en: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.pt: Ele me guiou e me fez andar em trevas e não na luz.
verses.en_web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
verses.en_bbe: By him I have been made to go in the dark where there is no light.

verses.en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.pt: Deveras fez virar e revirar a sua mão contra mim o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
verses.en_bbe: Truly against me his hand has been turned again and again all the day.

verses.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.pt: Fez envelhecer a minha carne e a minha pele; quebrou-me os ossos.
verses.en_web: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh and my skin have been used up by him and my bones broken.

verses.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.pt: Levantou trincheiras contra mim, e me cercou de fel e trabalho.
verses.en_web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.en_bbe: He has put up a wall against me, shutting me in with bitter sorrow.

verses.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.pt: Fez-me habitar em lugares tenebrosos, como os que estavam mortos há muito.
verses.en_web: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.en_bbe: He has kept me in dark places, like those who have been long dead.

verses.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.pt: Cercou-me de uma sebe de modo que não posso sair; agravou os meus grilhões.
verses.en_web: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
verses.en_bbe: He has put a wall round me, so that I am not able to go out; he has made great the weight of my chain.

verses.en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.pt: Ainda quando grito e clamo por socorro, ele exclui a minha oração.
verses.en_web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
verses.en_bbe: Even when I send up a cry for help, he keeps my prayer shut out.

verses.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.pt: Fechou os meus caminhos com pedras lavradas, fez tortuosas as minhas veredas.
verses.en_web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
verses.en_bbe: He has put up a wall of cut stones about my ways, he has made my roads twisted.

verses.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.pt: Fez-se-me como urso de emboscada, um leão em esconderijos.
verses.en_web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
verses.en_bbe: He is like a bear waiting for me, like a lion in secret places.

verses.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.pt: Desviou os meus caminhos, e fez-me em pedaços; deixou-me desolado.
verses.en_web: He has turned away my ways, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
verses.en_bbe: By him my ways have been turned on one side and I have been pulled in bits; he has made me waste.

verses.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.pt: Armou o seu arco, e me pôs como alvo à flecha.
verses.en_web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.en_bbe: With his bow bent, he has made me the mark for his arrows.

verses.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.pt: Fez entrar nos meus rins as flechas da sua aljava.
verses.en_web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
verses.en_bbe: He has let loose his arrows into the inmost parts of my body.

verses.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.pt: Fui feito um objeto de escárnio para todo o meu povo, e a sua canção o dia todo.
verses.en_web: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
verses.en_bbe: I have become the sport of all the peoples; I am their song all the day.

verses.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.pt: Encheu-me de amarguras, fartou-me de absinto.
verses.en_web: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
verses.en_bbe: He has made my life nothing but pain, he has given me the bitter root in full measure.

verses.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.pt: Quebrou com pedrinhas de areia os meus dentes, cobriu-me de cinza.
verses.en_web: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
verses.en_bbe: By him my teeth have been broken with crushed stones, and I am bent low in the dust.

verses.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.pt: Alongaste da paz a minha alma; esqueci-me do que seja a felicidade.
verses.en_web: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is sent far away from peace, I have no more memory of good.

verses.en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.pt: Digo, pois: Já pereceu a minha força, como também a minha esperança no Senhor.
verses.en_web: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And I said, My strength is cut off, and my hope from the Lord.

verses.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.pt: Lembra-te da minha aflição e amargura, do absinto e do fel.
verses.en_web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind my trouble and my wandering, the bitter root and the poison.

verses.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.pt: Minha alma ainda os conserva na memória, e se abate dentro de mim.
verses.en_web: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
verses.en_bbe: My soul still keeps the memory of them; and is bent down in me.

verses.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.pt: Torno a trazer isso à mente, portanto tenho esperança.
verses.en_web: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
verses.en_bbe: This I keep in mind, and because of this I have hope.

verses.en: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.pt: A benignidade do Senhor jamais acaba, as suas misericórdias não têm fim;
verses.en_web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
verses.en_bbe: It is through the Lord's love that we have not come to destruction, because his mercies have no limit.

verses.en: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.pt: renovam-se cada manhã. Grande é a tua fidelidade.
verses.en_web: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verses.en_bbe: They are new every morning; great is your good faith.

verses.en: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.pt: A minha porção é o Senhor, diz a minha alma; portanto esperarei nele.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
verses.en_bbe: I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.

verses.en: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.pt: Bom é o Senhor para os que esperam por ele, para a alma que o busca.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.

verses.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.pt: Bom é ter esperança, e aguardar em silêncio a salvação do Senhor.
verses.en_web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

verses.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.pt: Bom é para o homem suportar o jugo na sua mocidade.
verses.en_web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.en_bbe: It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.

verses.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.pt: Que se assente ele, sozinho, e fique calado, porquanto Deus o pôs sobre ele.
verses.en_web: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
verses.en_bbe: Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.

verses.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.pt: Ponha a sua boca no pó; talvez ainda haja esperança.
verses.en_web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
verses.en_bbe: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.

verses.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.pt: Dê a sua face ao que o fere; farte-se de afronta.
verses.en_web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
verses.en_bbe: Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.

verses.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor não rejeitará para sempre.
verses.en_web: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.

verses.en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.pt: Embora entristeça a alguém, contudo terá compaixão segundo a grandeza da sua misericordia.
verses.en_web: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.en_bbe: For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.

verses.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.pt: Porque não aflige nem entristece de bom grado os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.

verses.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.pt: Pisar debaixo dos pés a todos os presos da terra,
verses.en_web: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.en_bbe: In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

verses.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.pt: perverter o direito do homem perante a face do Altíssimo,
verses.en_web: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
verses.en_bbe: In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.

verses.en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.pt: subverter o homem no seu pleito, não são do agrado do senhor.
verses.en_web: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
verses.en_bbe: In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.

verses.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.pt: Quem é aquele que manda, e assim acontece, sem que o Senhor o tenha ordenado?
verses.en_web: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
verses.en_bbe: Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?

verses.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.pt: Não sai da boca do Altíssimo tanto o mal como o bem?
verses.en_web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
verses.en_bbe: Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?

verses.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.pt: Por que se queixaria o homem vivente, o varão por causa do castigo dos seus pecados?
verses.en_web: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.en_bbe: What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?

verses.en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.pt: Esquadrinhemos os nossos caminhos, provemo-los, e voltemos para o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;

verses.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.pt: Levantemos os nossos corações com as mãos para Deus no céu dizendo;
verses.en_web: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.

verses.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.pt: Nós transgredimos, e fomos rebeldes, e não perdoaste,
verses.en_web: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
verses.en_bbe: We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.

verses.en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.pt: Cobriste-te de ira, e nos perseguiste; mataste, não te apiedaste.
verses.en_web: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
verses.en_bbe: Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;

verses.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.pt: Cobriste-te de nuvens, para que não passe a nossa oração.
verses.en_web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
verses.en_bbe: Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.

verses.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.pt: Como escória e refugo nos puseste no meio dos povos.
verses.en_web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.

verses.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.pt: Todos os nossos inimigos abriram contra nós a sua boca.
verses.en_web: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
verses.en_bbe: The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.

verses.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.pt: Temor e cova vieram sobre nós, assolação e destruição.
verses.en_web: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
verses.en_bbe: Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.

verses.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.pt: Torrentes de águas correm dos meus olhos, por causa da destruição da filha do meu povo.
verses.en_web: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.en_bbe: Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.pt: Os meus olhos derramam lágrimas, e não cessam, sem haver intermissão,
verses.en_web: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,

verses.en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.pt: até que o Senhor atente e veja desde o céu.
verses.en_web: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.

verses.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos me afligem, por causa de todas as filhas da minha cidade.
verses.en_web: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.

verses.en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.pt: Como ave me caçaram os que, sem causa, são meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
verses.en_bbe: They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;

verses.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.pt: Atiraram-me vivo na masmorra, e lançaram pedras sobre mim.
verses.en_web: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
verses.en_bbe: They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.

verses.en: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.pt: Águas correram sobre a minha cabeça; eu disse: Estou cortado.
verses.en_web: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
verses.en_bbe: Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.

verses.en: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.pt: Invoquei o teu nome, Senhor, desde a profundeza da masmorra.
verses.en_web: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
verses.en_bbe: I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.

verses.en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.pt: Ouviste a minha voz; não escondas o teu ouvido ao meu suspiro, ao meu clamor.
verses.en_web: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
verses.en_bbe: My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.

verses.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.pt: Tu te aproximaste no dia em que te invoquei; disseste: Não temas.
verses.en_web: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
verses.en_bbe: You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.pt: Pleiteaste, Senhor, a minha causa; remiste a minha vida.
verses.en_web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.

verses.en: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.pt: Viste, Senhor, a injustiça que sofri; julga tu a minha causa.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.

verses.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.pt: Viste toda a sua vingança, todos os seus desígnios contra mim.
verses.en_web: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
verses.en_bbe: You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.

verses.en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.pt: Ouviste as suas afrontas, Senhor, todos os seus desígnios contra mim,
verses.en_web: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
verses.en_bbe: Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;

verses.en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.pt: os lábios e os pensamentos dos que se levantam contra mim o dia todo.
verses.en_web: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
verses.en_bbe: The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.

verses.en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.pt: Observa-os ao assentarem-se e ao levantarem-se; eu sou a sua canção.
verses.en_web: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
verses.en_bbe: Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.

verses.en: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.pt: Tu lhes darás a recompensa, Senhor, conforme a obra das suas mãos.
verses.en_web: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
verses.en_bbe: You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.

verses.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.pt: Tu lhes darás dureza de coração, maldição tua sobre eles.
verses.en_web: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
verses.en_bbe: You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.

verses.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.pt: Na tua ira os perseguirás, e os destruirás de debaixo dos teus céus, ó Senhor.
verses.en_web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.
